response.justification: Despite extensive software engineering experience, the candidate lacks relevant Java expertise for this junior role, has only basic German language skills (a hard requirement), and is overqualified with senior-level roles, suggesting misalignment with entry-level expectations and potential retention risks.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong track record in open-source contributions and technical workshops
Demonstrated agile practices and DevOps infrastructure experience
concerns: Only basic German proficiency — fails key communication requirement
No visible Java project experience despite listing it as a skill
Senior-level background contradicts entry-level role and may lead to dissatisfaction
